status: declared by the pull request that closes #1273 before any score was computed; a development study, never a verdict. (s3c) stays the H5 candidate until Eleonora rules on the result. Nothing is registered or published: no record in docs/runs/ is edited, the live record and its pin do not change, no declaration already merged changes, docs/research/h5-candidate.json, `gbm_funding`'s declaration, `scripts/final_test_preregistration.py` and metadata/sources.json do not change, no day after 2026-09-03 is scored and no lockbox day is scored. Amendments made after a number was computed are listed in `amendments`; there are none.
ruling: Eleonora, 27 October 2026, about 3:25 pm ET, chat, relayed on #1273: queue all four arms (net settlement, the GSE ramp, spike-sized carryover, MBS settlement days), one directive each, independent of each other.
hypothesis: H5 (primary goal): the SOFR - IORB spread distribution in bp. Step 3, an arm on the candidate (s3c). Development tier
target: spread_bps at the scored day, in basis points, as a 23-quantile distribution at each lead h = 1..5 (scoring_protocol.GRID)
why: (s3c) carries two settlement terms, `settlement_coupon` and `settlement_bill`, as 0/1 flags of the gross settlement being above zero (spread_mr_calendar.TermTable). What adds collateral and drains cash is new money: the securities settling less those maturing. The project already builds net settlement as announced (repo_model.net_settlement, metadata/net_settlement.json, #426); (s3c) does not read it.
premise_note: The directive says (s3c) 'sizes' its settlement terms by the gross settlement. In the tree the terms are flags (1 if the gross bill or coupon settlement is above zero), in standardised units; the sized form is the arm (r3) of #1172, which (s3) does not use. (s3c-net) therefore changes two things in each of the two terms at once: the gross flag becomes a signed size in units of USD 100 bn (needed to keep the sign of a net figure and to report a fitted effect per USD 100 bn), and gross becomes net. The control (s3c-gross) takes the first change alone, so that the page can say which of the two the result comes from. This reading is flagged to Eleonora on the page and in the pull request.

candidate.name: sc_s3c_net
candidate.label: (s3c-net)
candidate.definition: (s3c) with the two settlement terms replaced: in (s3)'s fit, `settlement_coupon` and `settlement_bill` enter as the signed NET settlement of the target day in units of USD 100 bn (the bill types and the coupon types separately: offering less the announced publicly held maturing amount, the SOMA leg cancelling), and not as 0/1 flags of the gross settlement. Every other term of (s3) (month-end, quarter-end, tax date, 19th to 23rd, post-month-end window), the Huber fit (k = 1.345), the ridge of 5 and the pool of standardised residuals are (s3)'s, as are the direct pairs; the SRF cap at the line from full allotment, margin 0 bp, is applied to its quantiles exactly as to (s3)'s (repo_model.s3c_candidate, unchanged)
candidate.module: repo_model.s3c_net (NET_ARM = sc.ARMS[2] with sized=True, NetSizeTable, constant_states, bp_per_100bn); the fit is repo_model.spread_mr_state_calendar's, unchanged and not edited
candidate.form: the sized arm of #1172 (sized=True) with the scarcity state held at its maximum (constant_states), so the sized regressor size / SIZE_UNIT * level(state) is the plain signed size / 100. A term enters a lead's fit when at least 3 training pairs have a positive column (spread_mr_state_calendar._entering); a negative net is kept in the column and in the forecast
candidate.sign: a net figure may be negative (more maturing than settling); the sign is kept in the regressor, the fit and the forecast
candidate.pairs: direct: the settlement terms are read at the target day with training_pairs = 'direct' (the estimation routine is guarded by one_step_guard with no allow-list entry); the provisional-register row is metadata/provisional/cleared/s3c_net_settlement_1273.json

net_read.source: the Fiscal Data auctions snapshot the published panel builds its gross settlement columns from (tests/fixtures/snapshots/funding_inputs/treasury_auctions/), read with repo_model.net_settlement.load_snapshot and the declaration metadata/net_settlement.json, unchanged. The snapshot of metadata/net_settlement.json itself ends at issue date 2026-01-15 and is not used
net_read.figure: repo_model.net_settlement.net_for_day over the auctions settling on the target day, bill types and coupon types separately (coupon = net less bills), unchanged: a class partly announced reads 0 until fully announced (#679), and a cash management bill counts only from its own announcement (#738)
net_read.instant: the decision instant of the forecast: 16:00 America/New_York on the decision day, the published records' decision time. An auction counts only when its announcemt_date is on or before the decision day (its announcement is stamped 12:00, as metadata/net_settlement.json declares). The declared net_settlement column of the target row is read at 12:00 on the target day itself, which is after the 16:00 decision of the day before, and is not used for the target day
net_read.lead: lead 1 only, as the gross flags are (spread_mr_calendar.TERMS, span (0,)); at leads 2 to 5 the terms are absent from the fit and the forecast, so (s3c-net) is (s3c) at those leads in the terms it reads, and differs only through the other leads' shared base fit (stated on the page from the cells)
net_read.training: a training pair reads the figure of its own decision, the target row less the lead, so a training figure and a forecast figure are the same function of the same announcements
net_read.new_read_path: repo_model.s3c_net.NetSizeTable is a new read path; tests/test_s3c_net.py holds its leakage test with one recorded mutation (the figure read at the target day's own instant instead of the decision's)
net_read.consistency: the gross settlement the net is built from is compared with the panel's treasury_settlement_bills and treasury_settlement_coupons on every scored target day and the number of days that differ is reported

control.name: sc_s3c_gross
control.label: (s3c-gross)
control.role: reference control, not an arm: (s3c) with the same change of form (the two settlement terms as signed sizes in units of USD 100 bn, no flag) but the panel's gross sizes (spread_mr_state_calendar.SizeTable, unchanged). It separates the change of form from the change from gross to net. It is a reference for (s3c-net), and is compared with (s3c) for context only

frame.windows: the two windows of #1255, loaded as #1255 loads them: the development window (decision days whose five targets fall on or before 2025-12-31; scripts/srf_cap_1241.py build_frame) and the 2026 development days (decision days whose five targets fall from 2026-01-02 to 2026-09-03, the near-blind tier open since GO #151; scripts/s3_2026_check_1222.py build_frame)
frame.walk: (s3) is #1145's walk (refit every 21 decision days, direct pairs), and the two walks of this study (one with NET_ARM, one with GROSS_ARM) start on the same first decision day and run over the same decision days as #1255's, so the arms are compared on the same days; the study checks that its walk's (s3) forecasts equal #1255's frame's, cell for cell, and refuses to write a record otherwise
frame.guards: a scored decision day or target day passes lockbox.require_unlocked through spread_mean_reversion_686.require_scored_days with the last day of the window; the blind tier (from 2026-09-04) and every lockbox day are refused; the net table reads only rows of the panel, which ends at the last unlocked day

primary.metric: grid CRPS (23 levels) averaged over leads h = 1..5
primary.pressure_probability: the Brier score of P(spread > +5 bp), the probability read off the 23 quantiles as 1 - F(floor(tau) + 0.5), F linear between them (spread_mean_reversion.exceedance), the event strict and on whole basis points (data.exceeds_bp)
primary.calibration: the coverage of the central 90% band (q5 to q95, closed) of every model, beside (s3c)'s, pooled and by regime; a rate, reported as a mean and not tested
primary.comparisons: (s3c-net) paired with (s3c), (s3) and the control (s3c-gross), and against B1, B1' and B2; the control is paired with (s3c) for context

scoring.scorer: repo_model.scoring_protocol (#655), the development tier: no verdict, no registration
scoring.test: scoring_protocol.paired_tests, the studentized stationary bootstrap (ruling 1), mean block 10 business days, 10,000 draws, seed 1273, two-sided 90% interval (the lower end is the one-sided 95% bound); the skill interval and the studentized interval on mean d are reported for every tested row; where the studentized bound cannot be computed (most of a group's days score alike) the unstudentized percentile interval of mean d is given beside it, with no reading taken from it
scoring.reading: a reading is taken from the mean-d bound (her ruling on #1009): (s3c-net) is read better than a reference when the lower end of the 90% interval of mean d is above zero, worse when the upper end is below zero, otherwise undecided. Lens C's caveat (the lag-10 HAC standard error is understated about 2x after 2020) is stated on the page
scoring.splits: pooled; by lead; by regime (the declared regimes); by pressure-day type of the target day (turn_days.reporting_day_type, the record in force); by calendar target-day type (#1115's groups); by target month (2026 window); and, at lead 1, the decision days on which the changed term is non-zero (the net bill or the net coupon settling on the target day is not zero) against the other days. The intervals of a group of target days keep the current method (the group's days, scattered, resampled in date order as if consecutive), which #1221 questions and #1228 will decide
scoring.identical_groups: a group in which an arm's score equals the reference's on every day is listed as identical and not tested against it; a group of fewer than 20 days is listed and not tested

effect.what: the fitted effect of each changed term in bp per USD 100 bn of net settlement: the standardised effect of the refit the forecast used (spread_mr_state_calendar.StateEstimate.effect at lead 1) times the scale at the anchor in bp, repo_model.s3c_net.bp_per_100bn
effect.report: by regime of the target day: the mean over the scored decision days, with the 90% stationary-bootstrap interval of that mean over decision days (an interval over days that share refits, not a sampling interval for the coefficient), the share of days on which the term was in the fit. The control's effect per USD 100 bn of GROSS settlement is reported the same way
effect.also: the mean absolute shift of the location in bp on the days the term is non-zero

reading_rules: A figure is a check on days that were already seen. Nothing here is a verdict, nothing is registered and no choice is made on it; (s3c) stays the candidate until she rules on the result.
A gain or loss is read from the 90% interval of mean d excluding zero; otherwise undecided. A point estimate alone is not read.
A pooled figure is never read without the regime and pressure-day-type splits beside it.
The changed term is read at lead 1 only, so the average over h = 1..5 dilutes it; the lead-1 row and the non-zero-term days are read beside the pooled figure.
The page ends with marked questions for Eleonora with numbered options and defaults that change no claim.
